svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Distributed Job Scheduler" id="P8O7gHPmF5f5rBSv_RUj"> <mxGraphModel dx="6124" dy="3468" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=24;fontColor=#222222;fontStyle=1;spacing=4;" value="Distributed Job Scheduler — Data Model, Indexing &amp; Execution" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="1700" x="40" y="8" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=1.5;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Goal:</b> run the right job at the right time, even when machines die &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Rule:</b> never lose a job, never let a double-run do damage, never let one slow job block the rest &nbsp;|&nbsp; <b>Example scale (assumed):</b> 10M job definitions · 50M runs/day ≈ 580/s average, ~10× spike at midnight ≈ 6k/s" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="44" width="1880" x="40" y="48" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-3" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 4;strokeColor=#b26a00;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=4;fontStyle=1;fontSize=14;fontColor=#b26a00;" value="START HERE — why not just use cron?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="1910" x="20" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Problem:</b> cron on one machine is a single point of failure — if it dies, jobs are missed. Add a second machine and now every job may run TWICE." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="590" x="40" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Decision:</b> separate WHEN (scheduler) from DOING (workers). Keep the schedule in a database, hand ready work to a queue, let many machines share the load." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="590" x="680" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-6" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Honest limit:</b> across a network, "exactly once" is impossible. We promise at-least-once delivery + idempotent jobs = effectively once." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="590" x="1320" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-7" edge="1" parent="1" source="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#1a56a0;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1a56a0;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-5" value="so"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-8" edge="1" parent="1" source="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-5" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;fontColor=#b85450;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-6" value="but"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-9" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 4;strokeColor=#1a56a0;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=12;spacingTop=4;fontStyle=1;fontSize=14;fontColor=#1a56a0;" value="A · DATA — which store for which data, and how each is indexed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="510" width="1910" x="20" y="260" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-10" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#222222;spacing=4;" value="<b>Blue</b> = the table and its columns &nbsp;·&nbsp; <b>Green</b> = how it is indexed &nbsp;·&nbsp; <b>Yellow</b> = why this store, and what it costs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="1800" x="40" y="290" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-11" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>1 · JOBS — SQL, sharded by job_id</b><br>jobs(job_id PK, shard_id, owner_id, name,<br>schedule_type (CRON / ONCE / INTERVAL),<br>cron_expr, timezone, payload, handler,<br>retry_policy, timeout_sec, priority,<br>status (ACTIVE / PAUSED), <b>next_run_at</b>)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="350" x="40" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-12" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>(shard_id, status, next_run_at)</b> as a PARTIAL index on ACTIVE rows → "what is due now in my shard?" is a short range scan. Plus UNIQUE (owner_id, name) and (owner_id, created_at) for "my jobs"." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="40" y="505" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-13" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Why SQL:</b> definitions are small, edited by people, need transactions. <i>Cost:</i> the due-index is the hottest in the system — keep it partial so it stays tiny." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="40" y="630" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-14" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>2 · JOB_RUNS — SQL, partitioned by month</b><br>job_runs(run_id PK, job_id, scheduled_for,<br>status (PENDING / QUEUED / RUNNING /<br>SUCCEEDED / FAILED / DEAD),<br>attempt, worker_id, lease_expires_at,<br>started_at, finished_at, error)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="350" x="418" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-15" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>UNIQUE (job_id, scheduled_for)</b> — one run per time slot, ever. <b>(status, lease_expires_at)</b> partial on RUNNING — finds runs whose worker vanished. <b>(job_id, scheduled_for DESC)</b> — history." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="418" y="505" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-16" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Why partition by month:</b> runs grow forever; old partitions are dropped or archived cheaply. <i>Cost:</i> more indexes = slower inserts on our busiest table." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="418" y="630" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-17" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>3 · SHARD LEASES — etcd / ZooKeeper (or one SQL row per shard)</b><br>shard_leases(shard_id PK, owner_id,<br>lease_expires_at, <b>fencing_token</b>)<br>workers(worker_id, last_heartbeat, capacity)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="350" x="796" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-18" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Primary key shard_id + compare-and-set:</b> "take the lease only if it is expired or mine". Every take bumps the fencing token, so an old owner's writes can be rejected." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="796" y="505" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-19" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Why a coordination store:</b> exactly ONE scheduler may own a shard. <i>Cost:</i> one more system; if it is down, no NEW leases — current owners keep going until expiry." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="796" y="630" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-20" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>4 · QUEUE — Kafka / SQS, priority topics</b><br>topics: tasks.high · tasks.normal · tasks.low<br>message = { run_id, job_id, handler,<br>payload, attempt, deadline }<br>key = job_id (spreads load)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="350" x="1174" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-21" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Partitions + consumer groups</b> — no secondary index; workers PULL the next message. Delayed retries use a delay topic / delay queue." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="1174" y="505" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-22" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Why a queue:</b> absorbs spikes and lets workers pull at their own speed. <i>Cost:</i> one more hop (milliseconds) and messages can be delivered twice." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="1174" y="630" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-23" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=11;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>5 · DLQ + HISTORY — dead-letter topic + object storage</b><br>dlq: { run_id, job_id, last_error,<br>attempts, first_failed_at }<br>history: runs older than 30–90 days<br>→ Parquet files in object storage" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="350" x="1552" y="325" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-24" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>DLQ is read by run_id / job_id</b> for investigation and replay. History is plain files in date-partitioned folders, queried only when needed." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="1552" y="505" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-25" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=10;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Why separate:</b> a poison job must not block healthy ones; old runs must not bloat the hot table. <i>Cost:</i> a replay tool and a retention policy to maintain." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="115" width="350" x="1552" y="630" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-26" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=none;dashed=1;dashPattern=8 style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>The life of one run (①–⑧)</b><br>① The job is created and its first next_run_at is set. ② The shard owner loads due jobs into a heap. ③ At the time, ONE transaction inserts the run and advances next_run_at. ④ The run goes to the queue. ⑤ A worker pulls it and claims it with a lease. ⑥ It runs the handler with run_id as the idempotency key. ⑦ Success, retry with backoff, or DLQ. ⑧ The reaper rescues anything stuck.<br><b>Control loops:</b> ⑨ leases · ⑩ misfire policy · ⑪ autoscale on lag · ⑫ metrics.<br><br><b>Example:</b> a daily 09:00 report for 5M merchants. At 09:00, 5M runs become due; shards spread the inserts, the queue absorbs 5M tasks, and workers draining ~6k/s take ~14 minutes. Priority lanes keep urgent jobs from waiting behind them — lag is the price of a cheap fleet." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="445" width="610" x="40" y="2745" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-138" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Architect decisions — say "why A over B"</b><br>1. Separate WHEN (scheduler) from DOING (workers).<br>2. The DB is the source of truth; the queue only carries ready work.<br>3. Compute next_run_at at write time → "due now" is an indexed lookup.<br>4. A partial, sharded due-index, not a scan of 10M jobs.<br>5. One transaction: create the run AND advance the job.<br>6. UNIQUE (job_id, scheduled_for) as the double-run guard.<br>7. Pull-based workers with leases, not push.<br>8. At-least-once + idempotency key, not chasing exactly-once.<br>9. Shard leases + fencing tokens, not one global leader.<br>10. Misfire policy per job; retries with backoff + jitter + DLQ.<br>11. Autoscale on lag, not CPU." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="445" width="610" x="670" y="2745" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g6C_Fg3Qy2n_5x41B_zl-139" parent="1" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontSize=12;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;strokeWidth=1.5;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacingLeft=8;spacingRight=8;spacingTop=2;spacingBottom=2;" value="<b>Mental model &amp; interview close</b><br><i>Define → Tick → Run row → Queue → Claim (lease) → Execute (idempotent) → Finish or retry → Reap</i><br><br><b>Trade-offs we accept</b><br>• Partial index + shards → more moving parts<br>• DB polling → about 1 s precision, not microseconds<br>• At-least-once → job owners must write idempotent handlers<br>• Leases → during takeover, jobs run late, not never<br>• Queue hop → a little extra latency<br>• Quotas and jitter → idle capacity, not-quite-exact times<br><br><b>One-line close:</b> "A scheduler is a promise about time: never lose a job, never let a repeat hurt, and be honest — with metrics — about how late it is."<br><br><b>Honest test:</b> kill the machine that owns shard 3 at 08:59:59 — does the 09:00 job run? It must: the lease expires, another instance takes the shard, and the job runs a few seconds late — once.<br><b>Extend later:</b> job dependencies (DAGs) · calendars and holidays · multi-region · a self-service UI." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="445" width="630" x="1300" y="2745" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: Distributed Job Scheduler — Data Model, Indexing & Execution

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 1862px; height: 1px; padding-top: 62px; margin-left: 30px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Goal: run the right job at the right time, even when machines die | Rule: never lose a job, never let a double-run do damage, never let one slow job block the rest | Example scale (assumed): 10M job definitions · 50M runs/day ≈ 580/s average, ~10× spike at midnight ≈ 6k/s

rect.style: stroke: light-dark(rgb(178, 106, 0), rgb(195, 133, 42));

box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #b26a00;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#b26a00, #c3852a); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: START HERE — why not just use cron?

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 572px; height: 1px; padding-top: 175px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Problem: cron on one machine is a single point of failure — if it dies, jobs are missed. Add a second machine and now every job may run TWICE.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 572px; height: 1px; padding-top: 175px; margin-left: 671px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Decision: separate WHEN (scheduler) from DOING (workers). Keep the schedule in a database, hand ready work to a queue, let many machines share the load.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 572px; height: 1px; padding-top: 175px; margin-left: 1311px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Honest limit: across a network, "exactly once" is impossible. We promise at-least-once delivery + idempotent jobs = effectively once.

div.div: A · DATA — which store for which data, and how each is indexed

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1794px; height: 1px; padding-top: 291px; margin-left: 25px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #222222;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#222222, #d0d0d0); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Blue = the table and its columns · Green = how it is indexed · Yellow = why this store, and what it costs

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 402px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1 · JOBS — SQL, sharded by job_id
jobs(job_id PK, shard_id, owner_id, name,
schedule_type (CRON / ONCE / INTERVAL),
cron_expr, timezone, payload, handler,
retry_policy, timeout_sec, priority,
status (ACTIVE / PAUSED), next_run_at)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 555px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: (shard_id, status, next_run_at) as a PARTIAL index on ACTIVE rows → "what is due now in my shard?" is a short range scan. Plus UNIQUE (owner_id, name) and (owner_id, created_at) for "my jobs".

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 680px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Why SQL: definitions are small, edited by people, need transactions. Cost: the due-index is the hottest in the system — keep it partial so it stays tiny.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 402px; margin-left: 409px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2 · JOB_RUNS — SQL, partitioned by month
job_runs(run_id PK, job_id, scheduled_for,
status (PENDING / QUEUED / RUNNING /
SUCCEEDED / FAILED / DEAD),
attempt, worker_id, lease_expires_at,
started_at, finished_at, error)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 555px; margin-left: 409px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: UNIQUE (job_id, scheduled_for) — one run per time slot, ever. (status, lease_expires_at) partial on RUNNING — finds runs whose worker vanished. (job_id, scheduled_for DESC) — history.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 680px; margin-left: 409px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Why partition by month: runs grow forever; old partitions are dropped or archived cheaply. Cost: more indexes = slower inserts on our busiest table.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 402px; margin-left: 787px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
3 · SHARD LEASES — etcd / ZooKeeper (or one SQL row per shard)
shard_leases(shard_id PK, owner_id,
lease_expires_at, fencing_token)
workers(worker_id, last_heartbeat, capacity)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 555px; margin-left: 787px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Primary key shard_id + compare-and-set: "take the lease only if it is expired or mine". Every take bumps the fencing token, so an old owner's writes can be rejected.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 680px; margin-left: 787px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Why a coordination store: exactly ONE scheduler may own a shard. Cost: one more system; if it is down, no NEW leases — current owners keep going until expiry.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 402px; margin-left: 1165px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
4 · QUEUE — Kafka / SQS, priority topics
topics: tasks.high · tasks.normal · tasks.low
message = { run_id, job_id, handler,
payload, attempt, deadline }
key = job_id (spreads load)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 555px; margin-left: 1165px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Partitions + consumer groups — no secondary index; workers PULL the next message. Delayed retries use a delay topic / delay queue.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 680px; margin-left: 1165px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Why a queue: absorbs spikes and lets workers pull at their own speed. Cost: one more hop (milliseconds) and messages can be delivered twice.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 402px; margin-left: 1543px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
5 · DLQ + HISTORY — dead-letter topic + object storage
dlq: { run_id, job_id, last_error,
attempts, first_failed_at }
history: runs older than 30–90 days
→ Parquet files in object storage

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 555px; margin-left: 1543px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: DLQ is read by run_id / job_id for investigation and replay. History is plain files in date-partitioned folders, queried only when needed.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 332px; height: 1px; padding-top: 680px; margin-left: 1543px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Why separate: a poison job must not block healthy ones; old runs must not bloat the hot table. Cost: a replay tool and a retention policy to maintain.

rect.style: stroke: light-dark(rgb(46, 125, 50), rgb(100, 168, 104));

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.div: Pull means a slow worker is never flooded. The claim stops two workers running one task.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1645px; margin-left: 971px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: The lease must be renewed (heartbeats) — more writes during long jobs.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1395px; margin-left: 1205px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
⑥ Execute
Call the job's handler with run_id as the idempotency key; heartbeat to extend the lease

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1525px; margin-left: 1206px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: If the task is delivered twice, the handler sees the same run_id and does the work once.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1645px; margin-left: 1206px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Handlers must be idempotent — extra work for job owners.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1395px; margin-left: 1440px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
⑦ Finish or retry
Success → SUCCEEDED. Failure → retry later with backoff + jitter. Too many failures → DEAD → DLQ + alert

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1525px; margin-left: 1441px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Backoff stops a failing dependency being hammered; the DLQ stops a poison job blocking others.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1645px; margin-left: 1441px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Retries add delay and load; retry only errors that can succeed later.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1395px; margin-left: 1675px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
⑧ Reaper
Every few seconds: RUNNING runs with an expired lease, and old PENDING runs, are re-queued (attempt + 1)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1525px; margin-left: 1676px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: A dead worker or a lost message must never mean a lost job.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 197px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1645px; margin-left: 1676px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: A slow-but-alive job may be re-queued too — one more reason for idempotency.

div.div: D · KEEPING IT HONEST — the control loops around the main path

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1825px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
⑨ Shard leases + fencing
Each scheduler instance holds leases for some shards, renewed every few seconds. If it dies, the lease expires and another instance takes the shard.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1917px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Exactly ONE scheduler per shard means two machines never fire the same job.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1997px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Takeover waits up to the lease time (say 15 s): jobs due in the gap run LATE, not never. The fencing token rejects a "zombie" old owner.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1825px; margin-left: 503px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
⑩ Misfire policy
Per job: if the scheduler was down and runs were missed — FIRE ONCE (catch up), FIRE ALL, or SKIP.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1917px; margin-left: 503px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Hourly report: fire once. Daily interest accrual: fire all. Cache warm-up: skip. The business decides, not the scheduler.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1997px; margin-left: 503px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: More options to explain, store and test for every job.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1825px; margin-left: 975px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
⑪ Autoscale on lag
Workers scale on queue depth and on scheduling lag = now − scheduled_for.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1917px; margin-left: 975px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: CPU says little here; lag says whether jobs start on time.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1997px; margin-left: 975px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Scale-up takes minutes, so keep a floor of workers ready for the midnight spike.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(218, 232, 252), rgb(29, 41, 59)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1825px; margin-left: 1447px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
⑫ Watch the right numbers
Scheduling lag · failure rate · retries · DLQ size · expired leases · queue depth, per team.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1917px; margin-left: 1447px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: The scheduler's promise is "on time" — lag is the number that proves it.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 427px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1997px; margin-left: 1447px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Per-team metrics cost storage; alert on trends, not on every blip.

rect.style: stroke: light-dark(rgb(178, 106, 0), rgb(195, 133, 42));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1896px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2083px; margin-left: 15px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #b26a00;
display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#b26a00, #c3852a); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: E · MORE DESIGN QUESTIONS — answered with their trade-offs

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 257px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2202px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Exactly once? Impossible across a network. We give at-least-once delivery + run_id as an idempotency key = effectively once. Cost: every handler must be idempotent.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 257px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2202px; margin-left: 346px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Time zones and DST? Store cron + an IANA timezone; compute next_run_at in UTC. Skipped hour → run at the next valid time; repeated hour → run once. Cost: extra rules per job.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 257px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2202px; margin-left: 661px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Everyone at 00:00? The queue absorbs the burst, shards spread the load, workers scale on lag, and jobs that do not need exact time get ±30 s jitter. Cost: jitter = not exact.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 257px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2202px; margin-left: 976px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: One team floods the system? Separate queues per priority and per-tenant concurrency quotas. Cost: more queues to manage; some capacity sits idle behind quotas.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 257px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2202px; margin-left: 1291px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Poll the DB or keep timers? Poll each shard every ~1 s for the next ~60 s, hold it in a heap, fire on the dot. Alt: pure polling = ±1 s jitter + DB load; pure in-memory = lost on crash.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 257px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2202px; margin-left: 1606px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Scale to 100× jobs? Shard jobs by hash(job_id) (consistent hashing keeps most in place), partition runs by month, archive old runs to object storage. Cost: resharding needs care.

rect.style: stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#b85450, #d7817e); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Step

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 542px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2416px; margin-left: 30px;

div.div: How to read it

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 592px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2960px; margin-left: 31px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
The life of one run (①–⑧)
① The job is created and its first next_run_at is set. ② The shard owner loads due jobs into a heap. ③ At the time, ONE transaction inserts the run and advances next_run_at. ④ The run goes to the queue. ⑤ A worker pulls it and claims it with a lease. ⑥ It runs the handler with run_id as the idempotency key. ⑦ Success, retry with backoff, or DLQ. ⑧ The reaper rescues anything stuck.
Control loops: ⑨ leases · ⑩ misfire policy · ⑪ autoscale on lag · ⑫ metrics.
Example: a daily 09:00 report for 5M merchants. At 09:00, 5M runs become due; shards spread the inserts, the queue absorbs 5M tasks, and workers draining ~6k/s take ~14 minutes. Priority lanes keep urgent jobs from waiting behind them — lag is the price of a cheap fleet.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 592px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2960px; margin-left: 661px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Architect decisions — say "why A over B"
1. Separate WHEN (scheduler) from DOING (workers).
2. The DB is the source of truth; the queue only carries ready work.
3. Compute next_run_at at write time → "due now" is an indexed lookup.
4. A partial, sharded due-index, not a scan of 10M jobs.
5. One transaction: create the run AND advance the job.
6. UNIQUE (job_id, scheduled_for) as the double-run guard.
7. Pull-based workers with leases, not push.
8. At-least-once + idempotency key, not chasing exactly-once.
9. Shard leases + fencing tokens, not one global leader.
10. Misfire policy per job; retries with backoff + jitter + DLQ.
11. Autoscale on lag, not CPU.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 612px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2960px; margin-left: 1291px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Mental model & interview close
Define → Tick → Run row → Queue → Claim (lease) → Execute (idempotent) → Finish or retry → Reap
Trade-offs we accept
• Partial index + shards → more moving parts
• DB polling → about 1 s precision, not microseconds
• At-least-once → job owners must write idempotent handlers
• Leases → during takeover, jobs run late, not never
• Queue hop → a little extra latency
• Quotas and jitter → idle capacity, not-quite-exact times
One-line close: "A scheduler is a promise about time: never lose a job, never let a repeat hurt, and be honest — with metrics — about how late it is."
Honest test: kill the machine that owns shard 3 at 08:59:59 — does the 09:00 job run? It must: the lease expires, another instance takes the shard, and the job runs a few seconds late — once.
Extend later: job dependencies (DAGs) · calendars and holidays · multi-region · a self-service UI.
